raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted thermochemistry sign conventions and system vs. surroundings. A reaction that “produces cold” absorbs heat from the surroundings (making them colder), which is endothermic (q_system > 0, ΔH > 0). The Planner incorrectly concluded this indicated an exothermic process and selected A instead of the correct B.
